programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.sub_title: Off Grid in the North Woods - Part 1
programs.desc: The Cabin Masters head deep into the woods in northern Maine to renovate a remote cabin; the team caravans in for a two-week build, facing rough roads and tight deadlines; this off-grid build was so ambitious, it had to be split into two parts!

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.sub_title: Off Grid in the North Woods -- Part 2
programs.desc: The Cabin Masters work to finish Nine Mile Camp; after whitewater rafting, Chase and the team build bunk beds, Dixie and Jedi design an archery target, and Ashley continues her quest for a bug-free build; can they get it all done in two weeks?

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: A family with a legacy of enjoying the lakes of Maine buys a 30-year-old gambrel garage with an efficiency apartment on the second floor.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.sub_title: A Cabin Tribute to Mimi Eva
programs.desc: The Cabin Masters help Chase's wife, Sarah, restore her late grandmother's cabin to preserve her memory; with only 12 weeks to build, the team works fast to update the interior with a new kitchen, bigger windows, and Chase's decorating style.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.desc: The team transforms the Boneyard by enclosing part of the shed with walls; they finish off the new space by covering one wall with multi-colored barn wood; Mark explores a German house barn and visits a log home built on a cliff.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.desc: The crew rebuilds the Minor Hill cabin in Franklin, Tenn.; Mark Bowe checks out a log cabin addition to an 1806 stone home and tours a local whiskey distillery built inside a timber-frame barn.
